changelog:
AEGIS (v8.0) - Security & Architecture Overhaul:
- [SECURITY] Unauthenticated endpoint closed: core/transmitter.php had no session or auth check. An anonymous POST could write to the database, write caller-supplied bytes into media/, and open an outbound connection to an attacker-chosen host.
- [SECURITY] CSRF and POST-only enforcement across every state-changing action. logout, escape_pod, export_station, remove_planet and alert_action were reachable by GET, so a single link or image tag could trigger them.
- [SECURITY] OTA updater RCE chain removed. The automated download/extract/execute path is gone; updating is now a documented manual procedure. The read-only version check remains.
- [SECURITY] SSRF guards on every outbound request. Node URLs must be HTTPS, on port 443, and resolve only to publicly routable addresses; the validated address is pinned to prevent DNS rebinding.
- [SECURITY] TLS certificate verification restored on all outbound calls, with hostname checking pinned. Forwarded headers are no longer trusted: client IP resolution uses REMOTE_ADDR unless the peer is a verified Cloudflare edge address, which restores the brute-force lockout and the rate limiter.
- [SECURITY] Session hardening: session id regenerated on login, strict mode, Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict cookies, idle and absolute lifetimes.
- [SECURITY] SQLite database denied over HTTP via .htaccess, dotfiles and the deployment-local directory blocked, directory listings disabled.
- [SECURITY] api_handshake.php rate-limited, and node removal from the public lighthouse directory now requires an admin token.
- [HARDENING] Database errors are logged instead of printed, media uploads are size-capped and typed from their own magic bytes, the visibility field is a strict allowlist, and Telegram alerts escape MarkdownV2.
- [FIX] Tactical signals (sonar_pulse, ack_receipt, scorched_earth, global_purge, resonance) failed on any station installed from schema.sql because its CHECK constraint only allowed 'public' and 'direct'. Fixed in the schema, with a migration for existing stations.
- [SYSTEM] The UI framework is now served locally and Google Fonts is gone. The node makes zero third-party requests, and the offline Bunker Mode service worker no longer depends on a CDN being reachable.
